title: Metaphoric Evolution, Linguistic Innovation, and the Global Horizon

sections.title: The Structural Mechanism
sections.content: Hungarian has taken in foreign concepts over the centuries and fitted them into native patterns. Just as the language reform (*nyelvújítás*) of the late 18th and early 19th centuries created thousands of new words, many of which survive, today the digital world undergoes natural metaphoric extension (*metaforikus kiterjesztés*).

sections.title: Rhetorical Application & Stance
sections.content: The internet is not a foreign territory; it is conceived through native directional cases (*a neten, a hálóra, a felhőbe*), showing how new concepts can fit into the existing case system; the image of language as a living organism (*élő szervezet*) is a metaphor too.
